answer_1.quote: The widespread use of Large Language Models (LLMs) across various fields has raised concerns about the safety of the output and the robustness of these models
tasks: Other:Jailbreak attack and defense in LLMs
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating harmful and jailbroken outputs from LLMs, analyzing activation patterns, and defending against unsafe generation, which falls under the broader scope of NLG safety and control.

answer_2.quote: we leveraged GPT-4o-mini (OpenAI, 2024) to score the quality of the outputs, ranging from 1 to 5, across five aspects: helpfulness, clarity, factuality, depth, and engagement. We reported the average score for each aspect and their macro-average score, denoted as Avg.
